descriptionChirho: The primary nominal sense of hatred as an emotion, disposition, or hostile attitude, encompassing all grammatical forms -- absolute, construct, with prepositions, and with pronominal suffixes. All seven clusters are inflectional or prepositional variants of the same abstract noun. Eng 'hatred,' 'and hatred,' 'with hatred,' 'and because of his hatred,' 'in hatred of,' 'their hate,' 'from your hatred'; spa 'odio,' 'y odio,' 'con odio,' 'y por aborrecerlos,' 'por odio de,' 'su odio,' 'por tus odios'; arb 'كُرهاً,' 'سِنْئَه,' 'وَبُغْضٌ,' 'بِبُغْضٍ,' 'وَلِبُغْضِهِ,' 'بِبُغْضِ,' 'سِنْئَتَم,' 'مِنْ بُغْضِكَ'; kor '미움이,' '미움으로,' '미움 그들의,' '네 미움에서'; swa 'chuki,' 'na chuki,' 'kwa chuki,' 'na kwa chuki yake,' 'chuki yao,' 'kutoka chuki yako'. All translations uniformly render this as 'hatred/chuki/odio/بُغْض' with only prepositional and pronominal variation.
